image_description: A top-down view of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) resting on a white, textured surface. The crab features a broad, oval-shaped carapace with reddish-brown coloration and lighter mottling. It has five pairs of legs extending laterally, with the first pair modified into large claws (chelipeds). The eyes are visible as small stalks protruding from the front corners of the shell.
